FX-PPG-001.says: The settings as added, at frames 0, 2 and 6: 20 red dots a second shot upwards from the middle at about 130 pixels a second, so fast they are out of the 16 by 10 layer within frames; the layer's own picture is gone.

FX-PPG-002.says: One still red dot of radius 3 in the middle, born at frame 12: nothing at frame 11, the dot at frame 13 and the same at frame 30 (it never dies).

FX-PPG-003.says: A tiny dot, radius 0.35: drawn at 0.7 and a quarter as strong.

FX-PPG-004.says: A round barrel of radius 4 (Barrel Radius -4): dots born scattered in a disc about the middle.

FX-PPG-005.says: A square barrel of radius 4: scattered in a square.

FX-PPG-006.says: The fountain: shot upwards from near the bottom, spreading 20 degrees either side, slowing and falling back, at frames 12, 24 and 40. Frame 40 drawn alone is the same as after frames 0 to 39.

FX-PPG-007.says: Direction 90: the fountain thrown to the right, falling.

FX-PPG-008.says: Direction keyed from -60 to 60 over frames 0 to 24: the jet sweeps from upper left to upper right.

FX-PPG-009.says: Particles Per Second keyed from 0 to 24 over frames 0 to 20.

FX-PPG-011.says: Gravity Direction 90: falling to the right.

FX-PPG-012.says: Gravity Force Random Spread 40: each dot falls at its own rate.

FX-PPG-013.says: Gravity keyed from 0 to 60 over frames 0 to 24.

FX-PPG-014.says: Gravity only on dots older than about half a second (0.51): they rise straight, then fall.

FX-PPG-015.says: Gravity only on dots younger than about half a second (0.51).

FX-PPG-016.says: Gravity older than half a second with an Age Feather of 0.6: some dots start falling earlier, some later.

FX-PPG-017.says: Gravity through the selection map: only dots over its white left half fall.

FX-PPG-018.says: Gravity from the Grid only: the Cannon's dots fly on unbent.

FX-PPG-019.says: The grid: 4 by 2 still yellow dots of radius 1 on a 12 by 6 grid, a new grid born on the last every frame, so the dots' soft edges fill in.

FX-PPG-020.says: The grid falling: a full grid born every frame, each falling from where it was born, streaks of dots under each grid point.

FX-PPG-021.says: Grid across keyed from 1 to 4 over frames 0 to 6, gravity 40.

FX-PPG-022.says: The holder exploded into 2-pixel pieces: at frame 0 its own picture exactly, then flying apart slowly.

FX-PPG-024.says: Pieces of 3 pixels, Radius 1.5: the right and bottom pieces cut short by the layer's edge.

FX-PPG-026.says: Exploding the logo layer, 4 by 4 in the middle: only its pieces.

FX-PPG-027.says: Exploding a layer that begins at frame 4, after the in point: nothing.

FX-PPG-028.says: Auto-Orient on: each piece turned to the way it flies.

FX-PPG-029.says: Fireworks: shells shot up, each bursting into 16 sparks about half a second (0.51) after it was shot, the sparks falling, at frames 18, 30 and 40.

FX-PPG-030.says: Fireworks with no age limit on the exploder: every shell bursts at birth.

FX-PPG-031.says: Exploder Radius 1: four sparks a shell.

FX-PPG-032.says: The exploded pieces burst again into four sparks each about a quarter second (0.26) in.

FX-PPG-033.says: Particles From for the exploder set to the Grid: the Cannon's shells fly on.

FX-PPG-034.says: The Layer Map: each fountain dot shown as the 4 by 4 logo.

FX-PPG-035.says: The Layer Map with Auto-Orient on: each logo turned to the way it flies.

FX-PPG-036.says: The Layer Map only for dots older than about a second (1.01): young dots stay dots.

FX-PPG-037.says: The Layer Map on the Grid: each still grid point the logo.

FX-PPG-038.says: The Layer Map naming the late layer, at frame 2 (not yet begun): the dots affected are not drawn.
